fields.description:
## Context / Problem
T13 (1,939 agentic runs), T14 (1,939), removal-rationale (1,722), and asserted-capability (409) have produced zero findings ever — ~7,900 wasted agentic executions. An adversarial false-negative audit amended the draft triggers (mechanism-of-enforcement vocabulary for T13; a structured file_impact condition plus scheduler/release vocabulary for T14; weakening vocabulary for removal-rationale; two regex bug fixes for asserted-capability). Amended fire rates over 743 reviewed non-bug tickets: 84.0% / 61.6% / 86.5% / 96.5%.

## ADR 0034 relationship
ADR 0034 (docs/adr/0034-llm-routed-enumeration-overlays.md) chose LLM-routed over lexical triggers for T13/T14 because a lexical trigger judged APPLICABILITY and over/under-firing on prose was deemed riskier than letting the router decide. This change does not reinstate lexical applicability judgment: the DET gate is a conservative PRE-FILTER in front of the unchanged LLM router — a fired plan still goes through exactly the ADR-0034 LLM routing; only plans where the criterion's subject vocabulary is entirely absent skip (measured: zero findings in 1,939 runs means zero would have been lost). The evidence and the pre-filter contract (skip only on total vocabulary absence; the LLM router remains the applicability authority for fired plans) are recorded in an amendment note appended to ADR 0034 in this change.

## Approach
T13 and T14 are overlay criteria (registry.is_overlay matches T-prefixed ids) and extend the existing _DET_OVERLAY_RULES path (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py:452-457). removal-rationale and asserted-capability are leaf-routed, NOT overlays, so they get a parallel _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES table plus a second gate block in orchestrator.route_criteria after the existing is_overlay-gated guard (orchestrator.py:392). Rule schema — precise semantics:

DetGateRule is a frozen dataclass with fields: `text_all: tuple[str, ...]` (regexes over the plan text, ALL of which must match — conjunction support; single-leg rules use a one-element tuple; asserted-capability uses two elements, the module-ref leg and the capability-verb leg), `file_impact_globs: tuple[str, ...]` (fnmatch patterns over each declared file_impact entry's `path`), and `file_impact_reason_re: str | None` (a regex over each file_impact entry's `reason` and `path` strings). A rule FIRES if (all text_all regexes match the plan text) OR (any file_impact path matches any glob) OR (file_impact_reason_re matches any entry's reason or path). The ticket model has no deleted-file flag — file_impact entries are {path, reason} — so the removal-detection arm is defined as `file_impact_reason_re = r"\b(?:remov|delet|drop|retir|decommission|sunset|prun)\w*"` matched against reason text (an author declaring removal work states it in the reason); there is no other deletion signal and none is invented.

Skip recording — named key and mechanism: route_criteria gains a `gate_log: dict[str, str]` parameter (criterion id -> rule name for every not-fired gate); its callers inside orchestrator.py pass a dict that the orchestrator merges into the existing routing coverage as `coverage.routing.det_gated` (a JSON object beside the existing agent_tier/single_turn lists), so every skip is visible in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar. The existing silent skip path at orchestrator.py:392-393 is updated to write through the same gate_log. route_criteria's complete caller set is updated for the new parameter: its orchestrator.py call sites AND production_batch_runner.py (which imports and calls route_criteria at lines 49 and 104) — the batch runner passes a gate_log dict and forwards it into its coverage output. Table representation migration: _DET_OVERLAY_RULES currently maps id -> plain regex string and overlay_triggers applies re.search per entry; the table values migrate to DetGateRule objects (the four existing entries T5a/T5d/T7/T12 become one-element text_all rules with no file_impact arms — a behavior-preserving conversion pinned by a test asserting identical fire/no-fire results for the existing entries on representative texts), and overlay_triggers is updated to evaluate DetGateRule. A not-fired rule performs zero LLM routing for that criterion; a fired rule routes to the LLM exactly as today. overlay_triggers gains an optional file_impact parameter threaded from route_criteria. sizing.py's is_overlay call sites are audited for the new table. Criteria and rubrics are untouched — this is gating, not removal.

Trigger regexes (case-insensitive; transcribed from the audit, provenance ticket 696a):
- T13 text_all[0]: `\b(?:block\w*|reject\w*|refus\w*|enforc\w*|den(?:y|ies|ied)\b|forbid\w*|prohibit\w*|disallow\w*|outlaw\w*|must (?:pass|not)\b|cannot (?:merge|close|claim|submit|land|push)|fail(?:s|ing)? (?:the )?(?:build|ci|check|gate)|gate[sd]? (?:on|behind)|require\w*[^.\n]{0,60}\bbefore\b|no longer (?:allowed|permitted|accepts?)|restrict\w*|bounce\w*|veto\w*|\bbar(?:s|red|ring)\b|exit(?:s|ing)?\s+(?:code\s+)?(?:non-?zero|[0-9]+)|\bnon-?zero\b|raises?\s+\w*(?:Error|Exception)|\bunless\b|prerequisite\w*|precondition\w*|hard\s+(?:requirement|stop|fail)|only\s+[^.\n]{0,40}\b(?:may|can|are\s+allowed)\b|now\s+(?:needs|requires)|turns?\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:run|build|ci)\s+red|goes\s+red|\bgate\w*\b|\bhook\w*\b)`; no file_impact arms.
- T14 text_all[0]: `(?:\.github/workflows|\bworkflows?\b|workflow_dispatch|pull_request_target|\bcron\b|schedul\w*|refs?/(?:for|heads|tags|meta)|branch(?:es)?\s*[:=]|branch (?:pattern|namespace|filter)|git ref|tag (?:push|pattern|creation)|release (?:script|pipeline|process|workflow|job)|new (?:ci )?job|entry[- ]?point|ci (?:job|trigger|run|pipeline|gate|workflow)|github actions|package (?:publish|release)|pypi|gerrit-verify|\bnightly\b|\bweekly\b|\bhourly\b|\blaunchd\b|launch\s?agent|dependabot|\brunner\b|\bmakefile\b|pre-(?:push|commit|receive)|commit-msg|console[-_ ]scripts?|\bwheel\b|\bsdist\b|publish\w*|upload\w*[^.\n]{0,40}\b(?:index|registry|artifact)\b|on\s+(?:every\s+)?(?:push|merge|tag)\b|\boidc\b|docker-compose|\bcompose\b|mirror[- ]guard|\bnamespace\b|lands?\s+on\b)`; file_impact_globs (".github/*", "Makefile", "*.pre-commit*", "hooks/*", "*/hooks/*", "pyproject.toml", "*.yml", "*.yaml").
- removal-rationale text_all[0]: `\b(?:remov\w*|delet\w*|drop\w*|retir\w*|deprecat\w*|prun\w*|strip\w*|weaken\w*|relax\w*|loosen\w*|eliminat\w*|decommission\w*|sunset\w*|rip(?:ping)? out|dead[- ]code|no longer|obsolet\w*|unus\w*|clean[- ]?up|simplif\w*|consolidat\w*|replac\w*|disabl\w*|bypass\w*|skip\w*|suppress\w*|silenc\w*|\bmut(?:e|ed|ing)\b|swallow\w*|demot\w*|downgrad\w*|soften\w*|supersed\w*|subsum\w*|\bfold(?:s|ed|ing)?\b|collaps\w*|inlin\w*|absorb\w*|\bno[- ]?op\b|waiv\w*|opt[- ]?outs?|turn(?:s|ed|ing)?\s+off|switch(?:es|ed|ing)?\s+off|shrink\w*|narrow\w*|exempt\w*|\bignor\w*|single\s+attempt|fail[- ]fast|\bbecomes?\s+a?\s*warning\b)`; file_impact_reason_re as defined above.
- asserted-capability text_all[0] (module-ref leg): `(?:[\w/]+\.(?:py|sh|ts|js|go|rs)\b|\b[a-z_]\w*\.[a-z_]\w*\.[a-z_]\w*\b|\b[a-z]+(?:_[a-z0-9]+)+\b|\b(?:module|helper|function|class|subsystem|registry|reducer|adapter|client|store|layer|service|component|pipeline|engine|wrapper|utils?|library|suite|script|hook|gate|sidecar|verifier|reviewer|table|command|test|check|flag)\b)`; text_all[1] (capability-verb leg): `\b(?:already\b|exist\w*|lean(?:s|ing)?\s+on|lives?\s+in|\bcovers?\b|takes?\s+care|responsible\s+for|does not (?:have|support|provide|exist|emit|handle)|doesn'?t (?:have|support|provide|exist)|lacks?\b|missing\b|no existing\b|must be (?:built|added|created)|not (?:yet )?(?:present|implemented|supported)|(?:provides|supports|exposes|implements|emits|handles|owns)\b|can(?:not|'t)?\s+(?:handle|do|parse|emit|sign)|(?:won'?t|will\s+not|never|only)\s+\w+|reus\w*|extend\w*|delegates?\s+to|calls?\s+into|nothing\s+in\b|wire\w*)`; no file_impact arms.

Alternative rejected: retiring the criteria — operator ruled they must remain; and the draft narrower regexes — the audit demonstrated realistic evasion classes for each.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py (route_criteria gate block + gate_log threading), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/production_batch_runner.py (route_criteria caller), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py (is_overlay call-site audit), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json (trigger annotations), docs/adr/0034-llm-routed-enumeration-overlays.md (amendment note), tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py (new, beside test_det_citation.py).

## Testing
Unit: every evasion sentence from the audit fires its trigger (parameterized over the recorded sentence lists); minimal non-matching plans skip each criterion with a coverage.routing.det_gated entry and zero LLM routing; a plan matching only one asserted-capability leg does NOT fire (conjunction test both ways); the T14 glob arm fires on a file_impact path of .github/workflows/x.yml with non-matching text; the removal-rationale reason arm fires on a file_impact reason "delete the legacy shim" with non-matching text; leaf-gated criteria skip through the new route_criteria block, overlay-gated through the existing one; fired plans route unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All audit evasion sentences fire their respective triggers (checked: `pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py` parameterized over the sentence lists).
- [ ] A not-fired criterion performs zero LLM routing and appears in the sidecar coverage under routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id with the rule name (checked: unit test through route_criteria asserting the gate_log contents and sidecar payload).
- [ ] asserted-capability fires only when BOTH text_all legs match (checked: single-leg negative tests in both directions).
- [ ] The T14 glob arm and the removal-rationale reason arm fire on file_impact alone with non-matching description text (checked: unit tests).
- [ ] Fired plans route the criterion exactly as before, and the migrated T5a/T5d/T7/T12 rules fire identically to the current regex strings on representative texts (checked: existing routing tests plus the behavior-preservation test).
- [ ] ADR 0034 carries the amendment note stating the pre-filter contract and the zero-findings evidence (checked: ADR text assertion in the new test file).
